content.text: In Nigeria, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-courses-without-teachable-stripe-which-architecture-actually-7|COREMERCH guide to selling]] software without Stripe or PayPal isn’t just inconvenient—it’s impossible. Both platforms exclude your country entirely, leaving digital creators with no payment processing, no product delivery, and no infrastructure ownership. Stripe’s country restrictions aren’t a bug; they’re a deliberate design choice that locks out entire economies. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-21|sovereign]] commerce infrastructure provides a permanent alternative. It’s not a workaround. It’s base-layer [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-courses-pakistan-without-stripe-3|The Real]] that you own, control, and deploy. This breakdown compares Stripe’s rented platform to COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack—a system built for regions where financial exclusion is the norm, not the exception.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Software stripe

Stripe offers a rented payment processing layer with limited tools for digital product delivery. It’s fast to set up but requires a supported bank account, which Nigeria lacks. You’re locked into their ecosystem, with no ownership of the infrastructure. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack deploys a complete, sovereign commerce system. It uses Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. You own every component after deployment. No subscriptions. No platform dependence. It’s infrastructure you control, not rent.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe excludes Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other regions due to perceived regulatory or financial risk. Their documentation explicitly lists unsupported countries, leaving creators with no recourse. Workarounds like proxy businesses or VPNs violate Stripe’s terms and risk account termination. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack is designed for these exact regions. It bypasses centralized payment processors entirely by using on-chain crypto payments. No KYC. No buyer accounts required. It’s built to operate in environments where currency collapse, payment rejection, and financial isolation are realities, not edge cases.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe processes payments instantly but charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. For Nigerian creators, the real cost is exclusion—Stripe doesn’t support your country at all. Even if you use a proxy, funds can’t be withdrawn locally. COREMERCH’s system uses NOWPayments for automatic crypto verification. Payments confirm on-chain within minutes. The 0.5% fee is lower than Stripe’s, with no additional charges. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The Edge Commerce Stack costs $197 for deployment, but you own the infrastructure permanently. No recurring fees. No platform lock-in.
Stripe’s country restrictions are deliberate—they exclude entire economies by design.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Stripe, you rent access to their platform. They control your payment processing, product delivery, and customer data. If they terminate your account, you lose everything. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack gives you full ownership. GitHub or Cloudflare hosts your store. Supabase stores your orders. Cloudflare R2 delivers your files. NOWPayments handles payments. Everything is automated and end-to-end tested. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access to your system. You own the code, the data, and the infrastructure. It’s not a platform—it’s your architecture.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a Stripe-supported country with a stable banking system, Stripe’s convenience might suffice. But for Nigerian creators, it’s not an option. Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only structural alternative. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack is built for your reality. It’s not a temporary fix—it’s a permanent system designed to operate in financially isolated regions. If you sell digital products and need full ownership, automation, and crypto payment processing, this is your architecture. It’s deployed in 48 hours, with 30-day support included. Choose sovereignty over rental.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use Stripe if I’m in Nigeria?
No. Stripe explicitly excludes Nigeria and other regions due to regulatory and financial risks. Even with workarounds, funds can’t be withdrawn locally, and accounts risk termination.
How does COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack handle payments?
It uses NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto verification. Payments confirm within minutes, with a 0.5% fee. Recommended networks like BSC and Solana keep transaction costs under $0.10.
Do I need technical skills to use the Edge Commerce Stack?
No. COREMERCH deploys and configures the stack for you. You receive full ownership and can optionally manage it yourself after deployment.
What happens after the 30-day support period?
You retain full ownership and control of the infrastructure. No ongoing fees or subscriptions. COREMERCH has no access to your system after deployment.
Can I sell any type of digital product?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack supports ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and more. File delivery is handled automatically via Cloudflare R2.
Own your infrastructure. Don’t rent it from platforms that lock you out.
